import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'research-agent'})
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
 'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse(t):
    o=[]
    for l in t.splitlines():
        if l.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')) and l[16] in (' ','A'):
            o.append(dict(rec=l[:6].strip(),name=l[12:16].strip(),res=l[17:20].strip(),ch=l[21],num=int(l[22:26]),
                xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]),b=float(l[60:66])))
    return o
def fasta(a): return ''.join(S.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta',timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])
def afmodel(a):
    m=S.get(f'https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{a}',timeout=60).json()[0]
    return parse(S.get(m['pdbUrl'],timeout=120).text)
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,Sv,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T));R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T;return R,qc-R@pc
b62="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ln=b62.strip().split('\n');cols=ln[0].split();BL={}
for r in ln[1:]:
    p=r.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): BL[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def nw(a,b,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b);NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    tM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);tx=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);ty=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1);tx[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1);ty[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=BL.get((ai,b[j-1]),-1)
            o=(M[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]);k=int(np.argmax(o));M[i,j]=o[k]+s;tM[i,j]=k
            o2=(M[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge);k2=int(np.argmax(o2));Ix[i,j]=o2[k2];tx[i,j]=k2
            o3=(M[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k3=int(np.argmax(o3));Iy[i,j]=o3[k3];ty[i,j]=k3
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]]));P=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if st==0: P.append((i,j));ns=tM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=int(ns)
        elif st==1: ns=tx[i,j];i-=1;st=int(ns)
        else: ns=ty[i,j];j-=1;st=2*int(ns)
    return P[::-1]
ASPH=fasta('Q12797')
A=parse(S.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/9FVU.pdb',timeout=120).text)
fe=[a for a in A if a['res']=='FE'][0]['xyz']
TIP={'HIS':['ND1','NE2'],'ASP':['OD1','OD2'],'GLU':['OE1','OE2'],'CYS':['SG']}
MAXSC={'HIS':3.45,'ASP':2.49,'GLU':3.76,'CYS':1.81}
CEIL={'HIS':5.98,'ASP':4.93,'GLU':6.45,'CYS':4.11}   # calibrated on ASPH His679/His725 CB-Fe = 5.73/5.66
def run(acc):
    q=fasta(acc); Dm=afmodel(acc); pr=nw(q,ASPH); m={j:i for i,j in pr}
    caA={a['num']:a['xyz'] for a in A if a['name']=='CA' and a['ch']=='A' and a['rec']=='ATOM'}
    caD={a['num']:a['xyz'] for a in Dm if a['name']=='CA'}
    cur=[(i,j) for i,j in pr if j in caA and i in caD and j>=560]
    for cut in [6.,4.,3.,2.5,2.5]:
        P=np.array([caD[i] for i,j in cur]);Q=np.array([caA[j] for i,j in cur]);R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
        dev=np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1);cur=[c for c,dd in zip(cur,dev) if dd<cut]
    P=np.array([caD[i] for i,j in cur]);Q=np.array([caA[j] for i,j in cur]);R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
    rmsd=float(np.sqrt((np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1)**2).mean()))
    for a in Dm: a['sx']=R@a['xyz']+t
    out=[]
    for a in Dm:
        if a['name']!='CB' or a['res'] not in CEIL: continue
        dcb=float(np.linalg.norm(a['sx']-fe))
        if dcb<=CEIL[a['res']]:
            dmod=min(float(np.linalg.norm(x['sx']-fe)) for x in Dm if x['num']==a['num'] and x['name'] in TIP[a['res']])
            out.append((f"{AA3[a['res']]}{a['num']}",round(dmod,2)))
    return rmsd, len(cur), dict(h679=(q[m[679]-1]+str(m[679])) if 679 in m else 'gap',
                                h725=(q[m[725]-1]+str(m[725])) if 725 in m else 'gap'), out
master=[]
for acc,nm in [('Q12797','ASPH (control)'),('Q5U4P2','ASPHD1'),('Q6ICH7','ASPHD2')]:
    rmsd,n,pos,cands=run(acc)
    master.append(dict(protein=nm,acc=acc,CA_pairs=n,RMSD=round(rmsd,2),at_H679=pos['h679'],at_H725=pos['h725'],
        ligand_positioned=', '.join(f'{c[0]} {c[1]}A' for c in cands if c[1]<2.6) or 'NONE',
        n_true_ligands=sum(1 for c in cands if c[1]<2.6)))
mt=pd.DataFrame(master); pd.set_option('display.width',240)
print(mt.to_string(index=False))

# ortholog counts (recomputed)
m1=re.compile(r'(.)[CTS]GPTN'); m2=re.compile(r'DDSF.(.)')
fa={}; k=None
for l in S.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene:ASPHD1+AND+taxonomy_id:7742&format=fasta&size=500',timeout=180).text.splitlines():
    if l.startswith('>'): k=l; fa[k]=''
    elif k: fa[k]+=l.strip()
orows=[]
for h,s in fa.items():
    if len(s)<250: continue
    a=m1.search(s); b=m2.search(s)
    if a and b:
        org=re.search(r'OS=(.+?) OX=',h)
        orows.append((org.group(1) if org else '?', a.group(1), b.group(1)))
od=pd.DataFrame(orows,columns=['organism','p679','p725']).drop_duplicates('organism')
c679=od.p679.value_counts(); c725=od.p725.value_counts()
print(f'\nASPHD1 orthologs, n={len(od)} species.  H679-equivalent: {dict(c679)}   H725-equivalent: {dict(c725)}')

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15.5,4.8))
ax=axes[0]
groups=[('ASPH\n(control)',[('H679',2.25),('H725',2.12)],'#2a6f97'),
        ('ASPHD1',[('R304',4.03),('H349',1.74)],'#b23a48'),
        ('ASPHD2',[('H283',2.31),('H328',2.11)],'#2d6a4f')]
x=0; xt=[]; xl=[]
for gname,items,col in groups:
    for lab,v in items:
        ax.bar(x,v,color=col if v<2.6 else '#d9a5a5'); ax.text(x,v+.08,f'{v:.2f}',ha='center',fontsize=8)
        xt.append(x); xl.append(f'{gname}\n{lab}'); x+=1
    x+=0.6
ax.axhspan(1.9,2.4,color='#2a6f97',alpha=.13)
ax.text(len(xt)+0.2,2.15,'Fe-N bond',fontsize=8,ha='right',color='#2a6f97')
ax.set_xticks(xt); ax.set_xticklabels(xl,fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylabel('nearest side-chain donor to Fe (A)')
ax.set_title('Metal site after superposition on ASPH 9FVU\nASPHD1 has one ligand, ASPH and ASPHD2 have two',fontsize=9.5)

ax=axes[1]
pdbs=['9FVU','6YYU','5JZ8','6YYX','7BMI']
h349=[1.74,1.84,1.77,1.82,1.65]; r304=[4.03,4.10,4.05,4.07,4.11]; rmsds=[0.84,0.88,0.88,0.86,0.89]
w=0.35
ax.bar(np.arange(5)-w/2,h349,w,label='ASPHD1 H349 NE2 (= ASPH H725)',color='#2d6a4f')
ax.bar(np.arange(5)+w/2,r304,w,label='ASPHD1 R304 NE (= ASPH H679)',color='#b23a48')
ax.axhspan(1.9,2.4,color='#2a6f97',alpha=.13)
ax.set_xticks(range(5)); ax.set_xticklabels([f'{p}\nRMSD {r}A' for p,r in zip(pdbs,rmsds)],fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylabel('distance to metal (A)'); ax.legend(fontsize=7,loc='upper center')
ax.set_title('Same verdict against 5 independent ASPH complexes\n(Fe or Mn; 2OG, NOG or inhibitor bound)',fontsize=9.5)

ax=axes[2]
lab679=list(c679.index); val679=[c679[k] for k in lab679]
lab725=list(c725.index); val725=[c725[k] for k in lab725]
ax.bar(np.arange(len(lab679)),val679,color=['#b23a48']*len(lab679),label='H679-equivalent')
off=len(lab679)+0.8
ax.bar(off+np.arange(len(lab725)),val725,color=['#2d6a4f' if k=='H' else '#d9a5a5' for k in lab725],label='H725-equivalent')
ax.set_xticks(list(range(len(lab679)))+list(off+np.arange(len(lab725))))
ax.set_xticklabels(lab679+lab725,fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel(f'ASPHD1 orthologs (n={len(od)} species)')
ax.set_title('Residue identity at the two ASPH Fe ligand positions\nleft: H679-equivalent (never His)  right: H725-equivalent',fontsize=9.5)
for i,v in enumerate(val679): ax.text(i,v+1,v,ha='center',fontsize=8)
for i,v in enumerate(val725): ax.text(off+i,v+1,v,ha='center',fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
